title: TreeRendererBenchPolicy
description: Config-as-code thresholds and closed-set definitions for the tree renderer benchmark harness (E5.1). Source of truth for the prototype benchmark that closes ADR-E0.5-10. Mirrors requirements.md NFR2 (tree-view p75 < 2.5 s on 10 K person mid-tier mobile), design.md §10.2 (virtualization/canvas/SVG hybrid, layout in Web Worker, stable node identity, neighborhood fetch) and scale-and-slo.md §3 (10 K/100 K synthetic dataset).

policyId.description: Stable identifier for the policy; must equal default-tree-renderer-bench/v1.

options.description: Closed-set of renderer options compared by the bench. Must include all three ADR-E0.5-10 candidates.

sizes.description: Synthetic dataset sizes exercised by the bench. 10K is required by ADR-E0.5-10; 100K validates the Y3 p99 worst-case budget.

interactionBudgetMs.description: p75 time-to-interactive budget for the chosen option on the 10K dataset, mid-tier mobile. Must equal 2500 (NFR2).

memoryBudgetMb.description: Peak heap budget per renderer on the 10K dataset, mid-tier mobile (proxy: Node RSS during bench run).

bundleBudgetKb.description: Maximum serialized runtime byte size of the chosen option's bench-mode JS payload. Proxy for first-load JS budget; real bundle enforced in E5.3.

layoutWorkerEnabled.description: Layout MUST run inside a Web Worker per design.md §10.2. The Node bench simulates the worker boundary via node:worker_threads with postMessage round-trip timing.

hybridThresholdNodes.description: Node count where HYBRID switches from SVG to Canvas. ADR-E0.5-10 default is 5000; the contract pins the numeric value here so the linter can validate it.

stableNodeIdentityRequired.description: Nodes MUST keep stable identity across re-renders (personId-based keys, not array index) so ABAC redaction and accessibility bindings survive viewport changes (design.md §10.2).

neighborhoodOnlyRequired.description: Browser MUST NOT load the full tree; only the viewport neighborhood is fetched per depth/direction. Bench measures layout over the fetched neighborhood.

a11yAcceptableScore.description: Minimum accessibility-cost heuristic score (1.0 = best). Weighted by: semantic alternative present, screen-reader ARIA cost, focus management cost, reduced-motion respect.

keyboardAcceptableScore.description: Minimum keyboard-navigation heuristic score (1.0 = best). Weighted by: arrow-key traversal cost, skip-link cost, focus trap cost, roving tabindex cost.

seedLocale.description: Locale used to derive the deterministic seed per scale-and-slo.md §3.3 (sha256(size + locale)).

auditClassOnBenchmark.description: Audit class emitted by the benchmark harness. The bench only reads synthetic data so the class is operational; switching to consent requires a new policy.
